criterios: This question asks for the combined total points scored by both teams in the regular-season NFL game between the Seattle Seahawks and Denver Broncos scheduled for Thursday, October 15, 2026 at Empower Field at Mile High, Denver (kickoff 8:15 p.m. ET). It resolves to the final combined score (Seahawks points + Broncos points), including any points scored in overtime, as shown on the official NFL box score for this game at https://www.nfl.com/scores/ . For example, a final score of Broncos 24, Seahawks 20 resolves as 44.
